# Nextill AI

## About
Nextill AI is an all-in-one AI-powered SEO platform for content creators and SEO professionals.

## Features
- Keyword Intelligence — AI-powered keyword research with difficulty, CPC, trend analysis
- Domain Intelligence — Website analysis with PageSpeed, technical SEO, and competitor data
- Post Generator — SEO-optimized blog post generation with 15-step workflow
- Plagiarism Checker — Content originality verification using PlagiarismCheck.org API
- AI Writer — AI-powered content generation using Gemini API
- AI Humanizer — Make AI content sound natural and human-written
- SEO Analyzer — On-page SEO analysis and recommendations
- Rank Tracker — SERP position tracking
- Backlink Analyzer — Backlink profile analysis
- Website Audit — Full technical SEO audit

## Pricing
- Free Plan: 100 credits/month, basic tools
- Pro Plan: $29/month, all tools, 500 credits/month
- Enterprise Plan: $99/month, unlimited access
